thread:
Priya: Quick sync — SableTech dedicated bring-up this Friday 04:00 UTC. Last checkpoint before cutover. Need final signoffs on quota numbers, autoscale window, and load test plan. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sabletech-bringup :link:
Sam: I can take ops lead for the run. Quota we committed: 4x A100 equiv GPUs (reserved pool), burst to 6 for 10m ok?
Marcus: Burst to 6 looks fine but suggest staged ramp to avoid warm-cache spikes. Plan I propose: 30m at 50% QPS, 15m ramp to 100% QPS, 30m soak at 100% with short bursts to 150% for 2m every 10m.
Zoe: I'll own billing + commitment notification. Also flagging renewal touchpoint — ops needs <1% error rate during soak to stay green. Anything above that and I'll need to escalate pricing risk.
Sam: Agree on Marcus plan. Can we add a short cold-cache pass (5m) before 50% stage so we prime KV caches?
Marcus: Yes — prepend 5m cold-pass. Also recommend jittered arrivals (Poisson) to mimic production.
Priya: Who's oncall? @eng-oncall needs to be present for the 100% stage and the immediate 30m after cutover. Sam you'll coordinate?
Sam: Yep, I'll create the pager rota. Oncall: me + Marcus for first 90m, then Zoe for billing followups.
Marcus: Load test script (k6 snippet):
```
export let options = { vus: 50, duration: '15m', rps: 1000 };
export default function() { http.post('https://dedicated.sable/api/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt:'test'}), {headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}}); }
```
Priya: Perfect. Can we confirm metrics to monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, queue depth, GPU mem pressure, token-per-second cost. Add error budget threshold at 0.5% for canary rollback.
Marcus: I'll attach dashboards to the runbook and set alert thresholds.
Zoe: Billing contact on file: sara@sabletech.com — I'm sending a quick note to confirm they accept burst billing for the day.
Sam: Small ops ask: please avoid changing model versions during the test window. We'll pin to v2.3.
Priya: Noted. Also capture customer feedback immediately after soak — 15m feedback call with SableTech PM. Marcus, can you prepare a short list of observed anomalies to share?
Marcus: Will do. I'll capture top 3 regressions and the top latency offenders.
eng-deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: dedicated-pool-sabletech -> Friday 04:00 UTC. CI: passed, canary: queued.
Priya: Final checklist for Friday: 1) Quota confirm (Sam) 2) Autoscale policy set (Marcus) 3) Billing consent (Zoe) 4) Oncall rota (Sam) 5) Runbook link + dashboards (Marcus) 6) Customer feedback call scheduled (Priya).
Sam: I'll post the rota and the call link by EOD. :thumbsup:
Zoe: Sent billing note, awaiting ack.
Priya: Thanks team. If we hit any perf surprises we'll hold the final cutover and run an extended soak. I'll update the ticket with go/no-go at T-6h.
Sam: Copy that.
Marcus: Prep scripts uploaded to /ci/loadtests/sabletech/ (sha: a1b2c3).
Zoe: Adding the renewal risk to the account doc so sales is aware.
Priya: Great — closing this thread. I'll ping again at T-12h for the preflight.
